name: 3-person tunnel tent
description: Three-person tunnel tent with two sleeping compartments and a porch for boots and bags. 3000mm hydrostatic head, taped seams and an aluminium pole set. Packs into two stuff sacks.

name: Two-person three-season tent
description: Two-person, three-season tent that pitches in about five minutes. One patched corner on the fly sheet, otherwise waterproof. Includes footprint and pegs. Roomy enough for two adults and day packs.

name: Down sleeping bag, -5°C
description: Mummy-style down sleeping bag rated to -5°C, with a draught collar and a full-length zip. Compresses to about the size of a melon. Recently cleaned and lofted. Suits someone up to 1.85m.

name: Twin-burner camping stove
description: Two-burner gas stove with a piezo ignition and a wind guard. Fits standard camping gas canisters. Boils a litre in under four minutes. The left burner simmers nicely; the right one is hotter.

name: 45L hard cooler box
description: Rotomoulded cooler that keeps ice for up to four days. 45 litres — enough for a family weekend. Has a drain plug and a bottle opener moulded into the lid. One small scuff on the base.

name: Rechargeable headlamp, 400lm
description: 400-lumen rechargeable headlamp with red night mode and three brightness settings. USB-C charging, about six hours on medium. The strap is adjustable and the tilt clicks firmly.

name: Folding camping chairs, pair
description: Two folding camping chairs with cup holders and a carry bag. Steel frame holds up to 110kg. The fabric is clean and the joints are tight. Easy to pack down for the car.

name: Double camping hammock
description: Parachute nylon double hammock with tree straps and carabiners. Sleeps two or one very comfortably. Packs to the size of a grapefruit. The straps are 2.5m each and have no fraying.

name: Aluminium camping table
description: Roll-top aluminium table that folds into a carry bag. Seats four for cooking or cards. The legs lock firmly and the surface wipes clean. A good height for camp chairs.

name: Gravity water filter, 10L
description: Ten-litre gravity filter that removes sediment and bacteria without pumping or power. Flow rate is about a litre every four minutes. Includes a spare filter cartridge. Great for camping and off-grid trips.

name: LED camping lantern
description: Rechargeable LED lantern with four brightness levels and a warm night mode. Runs up to 40 hours on low. USB-C charging and a fold-out hook for hanging in a tent. Two units available on request.

name: Steam cleaner with floor head
description: Pressurised steam cleaner for tiles, grout, oven doors and bathroom seals. Includes a floor head, brush and jet nozzle. Heats up in four minutes. Two microfibre pads are included and washed.

name: Cylinder vacuum cleaner, 2000W
description: Powerful cylinder vacuum with a HEPA filter and a 2.5-litre bag. Strong suction on carpet and hard floors. Includes a crevice tool and an upholstery brush. The hose has no leaks.

name: Carpet and upholstery cleaner
description: Spray-and-extract cleaner for carpets, rugs and sofas. Heats the water and pulls out the dirt. Includes a hand tool for stairs and car seats. The recovery tank seals properly.

name: Wet and dry shop vacuum, 30L
description: 30-litre wet and dry vacuum for sawdust, plaster dust, workshop mess and blocked sinks. Powerful enough for a garage or a renovation. Includes a hose, floor nozzle and a pleated filter.

name: Rotary floor polisher
description: Single-disc rotary polisher for hard floors, tiles and terrazzo. Scrubs, buffs and strips wax. Two pads included. Heavy, but the wheels make it easy to move between rooms.

name: Window cleaning kit, 3m pole
description: Three-metre telescopic window cleaning pole with a squeegee, scrubber and hose adapter. Reaches upstairs windows without a ladder. Includes a bucket and two spare blades.

name: Upholstery spot cleaner
description: Compact spot cleaner for sofa stains, car seats and rugs. Spray, agitate and extract in one pass. Heats the water for better stain lift. The brush attachment is new.

name: Drain cleaning auger, 10m
description: Manual drain auger with a 10m steel cable for sinks, showers and outside drains. The drum feeds and retracts smoothly. Includes a drop head and a boring head. Gloves recommended.

name: Gutter cleaning vacuum kit
description: Gutter attachment set for a wet and dry vacuum: 4m of hose, three shaped nozzles and a shoulder strap. Clears leaves and moss from gutters while standing safely below. Fits most 30–40L vacs.

name: Dehumidifier, 20L per day
description: Extracts up to 20 litres a day from damp rooms, drying laundry and basements. Auto shut-off when full, plus continuous drain hose. Castors and a carry handle. Filter was cleaned recently.

name: 3-ton trolley jack
description: Low-profile 3-ton trolley jack that fits under lowered cars. Lifts to 500mm with a smooth release valve. Includes a rubber saddle pad. Please use axle stands before going under a car.

name: Digital tyre inflator
description: Preset the pressure and it stops automatically. Plugs into the 12V socket and inflates a car tyre in about two minutes. Includes a long hose and a bright LED light. Reads in PSI and bar.

name: OBD-II diagnostic scanner
description: Reads and clears engine fault codes, shows live sensor data and checks emissions readiness. Works with most cars from 2001 onwards. Bluetooth app included. The screen has one small scratch.

name: 12V battery charger and maintainer
description: Smart charger with trickle and repair modes for cars, motorbikes and lawn mowers. Automatically stops when full. Comes with crocodile clips and an eyelet lead. Ideal for a car left standing.

name: Jump starter power pack
description: Portable lithium jump starter for petrol engines up to 6L and diesels up to 3L. Holds charge for months and doubles as a power bank. Includes insulated clamps and a case.

name: 1/2-inch impact wrench
description: Cordless impact wrench with 600Nm of torque for wheel nuts, suspension and rusty bolts. Two batteries and a charger included. Comes with four impact sockets. The battery latch is firm.

name: 4-ton axle stands, pair
description: Two ratchet axle stands rated to four tons each, with a wide base for stability. Adjusts from 280mm to 430mm. Please never rely on a jack alone — these are the safety net.

name: Car ramps, pair
description: Two steel ramps that lift the front wheels about 250mm for oil changes and underside checks. Rubber feet stop them sliding. Rated to 2.5 tonnes per ramp. Best on a flat, hard surface.

name: Telescopic wheel brace
description: Extending wheel brace for stubborn wheel nuts on cars and vans. Fits 17, 19 and 21mm sockets, plus a 1/2-inch drive. The telescope locks positively. Slides under a seat when closed.

name: Car vacuum cleaner, 12V
description: 12V handheld car vacuum with a 5m cable and three nozzles for seats, footwells and boot corners. Strong enough for crumbs and sand. The filter is washable and was cleaned after the last use.

name: Aluminium extension ladder, 3.5m
description: Three-section aluminium extension ladder reaching 3.5m, with a stabiliser bar and rubber feet. Fits in a hatchback when collapsed. The rope and pulley run freely. Please return it dry.

name: 6ft fibreglass step ladder
description: Fibreglass stepladder, six steps, with a fold-out tray for tools. Non-conductive, so it is the safer choice near wiring. Rated to 150kg. The treads and locking arms are in good shape.

name: 8-inch Dobsonian telescope
description: Eight-inch Dobsonian reflector for planets, the moon and brighter deep-sky objects. Comes with two eyepieces, a finder scope and a collimation cap. The base swivels smoothly. Please handle it gently.
